prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N[C@@H](Cc1ccccc1)[C@@H](O)C[C@@H](Cc1ccccc1)C(=O)N[C@H]1c2ccccc2OC[C@H]1O
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL243

You are given no information about either assay protocol.

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.55, "error_class": "none", "reason": "This compound appears to be a well-characterized HIV protease inhibitor (resembling nelfinavir/KNI-type inhibitors) tested against CHEMBL243 (HIV-1 protease), and IC50 values for potent, well-behaved protease inhibitors measured in standard enzymatic assays typically agree within 0.3 log units across independent reports."}

parsed.reason: This compound appears to be a well-characterized HIV protease inhibitor (resembling nelfinavir/KNI-type inhibitors) tested against CHEMBL243 (HIV-1 protease), and IC50 values for potent, well-behaved protease inhibitors measured in standard enzymatic assays typically agree within 0.3 log units across independent reports.
